SELECT c.id AS cakeId, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor, #{cakeSize} AS cakeSize, COALESCE(r.reservation_quantity, 0) AS reservationQuantity, COALESCE(( SELECT s.quantity FROM cake_stocks s WHERE s.cake_id = c.id AND s.cake_size = #{cakeSize} ), 0) AS stockQuantity FROM cakes c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cake_id, COUNT(*) AS reservation_quantity FROM reservations WHERE res_date = #{today} AND cake_size = #{cakeSize} AND status = 'RESERVED' GROUP BY cake_id ) r ON r.cake_id = c.id
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservations today_reservation WHERE today_reservation.cake_id = c.id AND today_reservation.res_date = #{today} AND today_reservation.cake_size = #{cakeSize} AND (today_reservation.contact IS NULL OR today_reservation.contact != 'ON_SITE') )
ORDER BY c.id ASC
